children: ScottyCon is an annual anime/video game convention at Carnegie Mellon University founded by Cosplay@CMU, Artist Alley Club, CMU Esports, and Vermillion Anime Club. We aim to provide an affordable single-day convention, collaborating with CMU organizations and the greater Pittsburgh community. In the past, ScottyCon has included an artist alley, cosplay masquerade, live band performances, arcade cabinets, fighting game locals, anime screenings, and craft activities. We are hosted in March at the Carnegie Mellon Cohon University Center.

attributes.class: N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-l9agd6d32 comp-l9agd6d32__item-lcy7gwpg wixui-rich-text

children: No, you do not need to purchase tickets. Instructions for a free ticket will be emailed in the Spring. If your club has been accepted to host an activity, we can provide a certain number of free tickets (details to be communicated at a later date). Note that we cannot provide free tickets to masquerade participants.
